ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The lower part of the figure is the Yangtze River channel, and the channel takes on a curved form near the city; the water transport wharf is marked on the side close to the outer side of the river bend and subjected to scouring by the main current. Then reason: In a river bend, the outer bank is usually the concave bank, where the water flow speed is relatively fast and the scouring effect is strong, so sediment is not easy to deposit; the inner convex bank has a relatively slow flow speed and is easy to silt up. Therefore, the water transport wharf that has not silted up for decades is most likely located on the concave bank of the river.
